info.name: SSM Driver API
info.description: SSM mobile API for the **Driver** app. Auth: opaque bearer token from `POST /auth/delivery-man/login`. Approval gate: pending drivers can only use onboarding routes. There is no driver logout endpoint. Import together with `SSM_LOCAL.postman_environment.json`. See docs/SSM_DRIVER_API_GUIDE.md.

item.name: 01 Registration & Onboarding (pending account)
item.description: Self-registration creates a PENDING driver (inactive). A pending driver can log in and call the onboarding routes only; every operational route returns HTTP 403 `driver-not-approved` until an admin approves the account in the SSM admin panel.

request.description: JSON body. `identity_type` is one of passport | driving_license | nid; `earning` is required by the legacy validator (send 1). Password needs upper/lower case, digit and symbol (min 8).

item.name: 06 Dispatch scenarios (automatic offers)
item.description: Automatic dispatch starts when the Merchant marks the Order ready. The nearest eligible driver gets exactly one offer (30 s in production; shortened on the local test server). A rejected/expired driver is excluded and the next nearest driver is offered. Sub-folders are meant to be run in order by the scenario runner; assertions use `dispatch_expect_a|b|c`.

request.description: Which drivers hold an offer is asserted by `dispatch_expect_a` (`offer` or `none`), set by the scenario runner.

item.name: 08 Current work & Delivery
item.description: Driver lifecycle for the accepted order: `driver_accepted` → pickup → `picked_up` → out-for-delivery → `out_for_delivery` → complete (with proof) → `delivered`. Every lifecycle POST needs an `Idempotency-Key` header (replays return `idempotent_replay: true`). Proof is `otp` (6 digits shown to the customer via `POST /customer/orders/{id}/delivery-otp/request`) or `location_time` (latitude/longitude).

item.name: 10 Parcel work
item.description: Warehouse parcels assigned to the driver by an admin (`ARRIVED_AT_WAREHOUSE` → optional `start-delivery` → `OUT_FOR_DELIVERY` → `complete` → `DELIVERED`). `complete` may be called straight from the warehouse state and is idempotent once delivered (HTTP 200, current state). Proof is `OTP` or `LOCATION_TIME`. COD parcels record the cash collection when `cod_collected` is true. Only id, first name and last name of the customer are exposed to the driver.

exec: try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { json = null; }
